newsitem.title: JAPAN: NTT gets data communication licence from UK--Jiji.
newsitem.headline: NTT gets data communication licence from UK--Jiji.

text.p: Britain has awarded Nippon Telegraph and Telephone Corp (NTT) a licence to operate a digital data communications service connecting Britain with France, Germany and the United States, Japan's Jiji news agency reported on Thursday.
Jiji said NTT's unit in Britain made an application to the British government to operate the service on Wednesday and it was approved immediately.
An NTT spokeswoman confirmed the application had been made but said she could not immediately confirm if it had been accepted because of the time difference between Japan and Britain.
She said NTT had made similar applications in France and Germany on Wednesday.

NTT president Junichiro Miyazu said on Wednesday that the company hopes to start providing international telephone services to multinational companies in Europe, the United States and Asia by the end of this year.
The firm said it hoped to apply soon for licences in the United States and Asia.
NTT does not currently handle international telecommunications services.
